title: Numerical Symbolism and the Lambs
english: My flesh has sprouted in doing these things, aiding my heart. Perhaps also the hoping heart will be aided, the flesh having risen according to the time of the resurrection, enjoying it. Near to this, even our bones sprout like herbs. For our body now holds the word of a seed toward the resurrection; for this very thing, having been sown in corruption, sprouts in incorruption, being sown. Paul also used the example of that which is sown regarding the things of the resurrection.

And I will confess to him according to my will. Many, through fear of punishment or shame, or because they are being reproached by men, forbid sins by disposition, enjoying them. But the critical man, having seen the mystery and the harm of sins, voluntarily turns away from them, confessing them to God of his own will. And if 'I will confess to him' signifies thanksgiving, someone does it according to his will, being thankful for all things that happen, even if something seems unpleasant. For those thanking only in things that please, they do not do it of their own will, but are driven to this by pleasure.

The people of God have nothing else as a stronghold except the Lord himself being their refuge and fortress (Ps 27:8). He himself is the Lord and the defender of the salvations of Christ. And every partaker of Christ is called 'Christ' homonymously with him. He who is not saved of the salvations, his Christ is not a defender; but if he is a defender of the salvations of Christ, the Son of the one who is, then salvation is heard through him by which he saves.

Save this your people, for you are a stronghold, blessing your inheritance; not like any other people (Ps 27:9). Bless it with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly things, lifting them up and suspending them through virtue, but also shepherding them into all this age. For in the future, having surpassed the state of being fed, they will be a pupil and a teacher to you.

The preceding psalm, containing greatest mysteries, is rightly arranged according to the twenty-seventh number, the power of the seven (Ps 28,1a). If indeed you combine the six numbers from unity as a seven, the twenty-seventh is composed; and it is a triangle, each of its sides being composed of seven. It is also a perfect number, second after the ten. For they say a perfect number is one composed of its own parts, so as not to exceed or fall short. And the present one is a number having parts: half, fourth, seventh, fourteenth, twenty-seventh; all being combined, it completes itself.

Protect then those who have the spirit of adoption by the angels, to bring upon the tent those things for healing (Ps 28,1b–2); and they carry [glory], and they are also sons of the lambs. Lambs ought to be considered those who return to a life of godliness according to piety, without logically contemplating the truth. Therefore they are also sufficient to rule, and sons of lambs are those born of the imitation of their way of life. Those having correctly and justly and piously received the Trinity carry glory, but those guarding the commandments of the Lord carry honor. For he who transgresses the law, by transgressing, dishonors God; honor he offers to Him, the one who is contained by the divine law. Bring glory to the Lord in His name; likewise to Him before Him. Worship the Lord in His holy court. He who worships God according to the ecclesiastical doctrines and the blameless canons of it, worships the Lord in His holy court.

Someone, imposing a more superficial interpretation, will say of John baptizing in the Jordan river, 'A voice of the Lord upon the waters' (Ps 28,3a). Yet John, having taken up a more pleasant and austere life, making the flame of the pleasures of life manageable, is a voice of the Lord cutting the flame of fire (Ps 28,7).
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
